reference.title: Effect of metabolic blockade on the psychoactive effects of dextromethorphan.
reference.abstract: Compared to DM alone, quinidine pre-treatment inhibited DM metabolism and changed its subjective effects, demonstrating that the psychoactive properties of DM are a function of drug metabolism. These results demonstrate the relationship between CYP2D6 activity, plasma drug levels, and psychoactive drug effects, and have implications for both the abuse liability and therapeutic utility of DM.
